relevance_note: A cohort deep-sequencing study that reports three patients with MOSAIC (not germline) TNFAIP3 variants and lymphoproliferation, none given an HA20 diagnosis: "Three patients with lymphoproliferation had mosaic variants in TNFAIP3 leading to premature termination and haploinsufficiency (Patient IDs 66, 99, and 507)."
method_note: Read the full Markdown by hand; values hand-entered into a small Python build script (no table transcription). The Markdown contains no Tables 1-4 and no supplemental tables (S5 clinical details, S6 scoring), so per-patient VAF, sex, age, clinical details and per-variant mosaic classification are unavailable; all such fields are 'not reported'. Scope: only the three individuals with TNFAIP3 variants (Patient 66, Patient 99, Patient ID 507) were extracted; the many other cohort patients with variants only in other genes (FAS, STAT3, NRAS, UBA1, TP53, etc.) were not given rows. The TNFAIP3 variants are mosaic (zygosity 'mosaic'); inheritance and parental testing are not reported; the authors do not diagnose HA20 and say causality is unestablished. Labels: the paper calls these people 'Pt. ID 66'/'ID 66'/'Patient 66', 'ID 99'/'Patient 99' and 'Patient ID 507'; verbatim forms 'Patient 66', 'Patient 99', 'Patient ID 507' are used. Gene-level statement 'mosaic variants in SAMD9L, TNFAIP3, OAS1, and TP53 were classified as LMP' does not say which TNFAIP3 variants, so LMP was not assigned per variant. Variant class for p.Leu147Glnfs left 'not reported' because the text never names its class for that patient (only the group phrase 'predicted LOF (nonsense and frameshift)'). 'Immune dysregulation' rows use the group statement that all affected individuals had immune dysregulation, plus the abstract naming TNFAIP3 among genes mosaic in affected undiagnosed patients. cites_prior_report_of_same_patients set true because the paper says 230 of its patients were also analysed in an accompanying manuscript by Ghosh et al. and that the TNFAIP3 p.Tyr246Ter variant (Pt. ID 66) was detected by both methods; note this is a concurrent, not an earlier, publication. Reference 34 (Yan et al. 2021) is cited for the p.Leu147Glnfs variant causing germline HA20, not as a prior report of Patient ID 507. Contradictions in the paper (not about TNFAIP3 patients): '25 variants identified by deep sequencing were not identified with exome reanalysis' vs 'Most mosaic variants (22/27) ... were not detected by exome sequencing'; and denominators '(18/49)' vs '(5/50)' for the Ghosh et al. variants.
